snippet.title: House Builder - Tiny Houses DLC Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Discover the charms of minimalism and clever design in the new DLC for House Builder: Tiny Houses! Build capsule houses, mobile marvels, and restore a classic camper van. Each project will transport you to a world of smart solutions, mobility, and living in harmony with nature.

Download and play now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4218810/House_Builder__Tiny_Houses_DLC/

#housebuilder #tinyhousesdlc #simulator
